verdict.rationale: Scheduled or background automations, such as recurring re-indexing, sync jobs or triggers, are a plausible capability for a search engine or SaaS, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents none of them. The Typesense Cloud MCP server lets an agent configure clusters and index data interactively from a conversation, which is not autonomous background automation. Auto Scaling is a managed infrastructure feature, not user-defined automation.
